Original readme licence statement: このプラグインのライセンスは吉里吉里本体に準拠してください。
The original KiriKiri/W.Dee and contributors notice is retained in krkrz.txt.
Full reference hashes are recorded in ../krkr-bound-xp3-label-sources.json.
No DirectShow/COM implementation, temporary-file extraction, framebuffer copier,
private playback clock or native executable code is adopted. Native semantic
methods/callback/resource/wait policy is independently maintained in the
first-class crysirror-krkr crate and calls engine-owned Media/Canvas services.
